| **Cormoran Strike** (written under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith) | *The Cuckoo’s Calling* | 2013 |
| | *The Silkworm* | 2014 |
| | *Career of Evil* | 2015 |
| | *Lethal White* | 2018 |
| | *Troubled Blood* | 2020 |
